episodes.synopsis: Despised by her stepmother and sister, Miyo is treated like a servant in her own home. One day, her father calls her in to discuss her future.
episodes.title: The Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Determined to be of use, Miyo wakes up early and prepares breakfast, but Kiyoka accuses her of trying to poison him and refuses to take a bite.
episodes.title: About My Husband-to-Be

episodes.synopsis: While Kiyoka takes Miyo out to town, he quickly notices that she behaves very differently from other wealthy daughters he's encountered.
episodes.title: Our First Date

episodes.synopsis: To surprise Kiyoka with a handmade gift, Miyo goes into town to shop for some material. Meanwhile, Kiyoka pays Miyo's parents a visit.
episodes.title: The Gift

episodes.synopsis: Engulfed with jealousy, Kaya tries to thwart Miyo's engagement to Kiyoka. Miyo leaves the house and forgets to bring the good luck charm Kiyoka gave her.
episodes.title: Ripples

episodes.synopsis: Miyo wakes up to her sister and stepmother threatening her. Together with Koji, Kiyoka arrives at the Saimori home and demands to see his fiancée.
episodes.title: Determination and Thunder

episodes.synopsis: Kiyoka accompanies Miyo to the remains of the Saimori home at her request. Later, a stunning visitor comes by their home.
episodes.title: Glamorous Lady of Summer

episodes.synopsis: Hazuki and Miyo grow closer through their lessons. Worried, Kiyoka tries to get to the bottom of Miyo's relentless nightmares.
episodes.title: Nightmares and Ominous Shadows

episodes.synopsis: Though distressed by her nightmares, Miyo keeps pushing herself to be a supportive wife. Then, Arata Tsuruki comes to speak to her while Kiyoka is away.
episodes.title: Drowning in Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Arata reveals his true identity and introduces Miyo to the grandfather she never knew. They claim they can cure her nightmares — on one condition.
episodes.title: Summer Cherry Blossoms, and the Mistake

episodes.synopsis: Yoshiro Usuba tells Miyo about how her mother came to marry her father — and why she made a decision that changed her only daughter's life forever.
episodes.title: My Mother's Legacy

episodes.synopsis: Miyo's powers are everyone's last hope of waking Kiyoka from his unconscious state. But before she can rescue him, she must face the shadow of her past.
episodes.title: Light in the Darkness
